description: This PHP source file defines the class `updatePortal`, which manages updating user information and sending email notifications related to portal account access in a SuiteCRM system. It contains methods for updating users (`updateUser`) and for sending emails (`sendEmail`). The class interacts with email templates, email system configurations, and external email components.

classes.name: updatePortal
classes.description: Class responsible for updating portal user access and sending notification emails in the SuiteCRM environment.

methods.name: updateUser
methods.description: Updates portal user access details for a contact, including email notifications if enabled.

methods.name: sendEmail
methods.description: Constructs and sends an email via the system, creating an Email bean record upon successful delivery.
